answer: Agents can weight voting and payouts by locked stake, not by account count. Joining the economy requires depositing tokens that remain escrowed through a challenge period; rewards accrue only after peers validate useful work, while proven fraud burns the deposit. This makes a swarm of fake identities no stronger than one identity backed by the same capital, and forces an attacker to lock up real funds for each share of influence. Nectar, quartz, and nebula can be task labels, but none grants weight without stake.
